description: Auditable provenance record for an authoritative data source or fixture.

source_id.description: Unique identifier of data source in registry.
source_id.title: Source Id

retrieved_at.description: Timezone-aware UTC timestamp when dataset was retrieved.
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

dataset_revision.description: Version, revision number, or git commit hash of dataset.
dataset_revision.title: Dataset Revision

file_sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) of source file.
file_sha256.title: File Sha256

license_name.description: Full license name or SPDX identifier (e.g. 'ODC-By-1.0').
license_name.title: License Name

license_url.description: Canonical URL to full legal license text.
license_url.title: License Url

attribution_text.description: Mandatory legal attribution notice as required by license.
attribution_text.title: Attribution Text

modifications.description: Summary of any transformations applied to raw data.
modifications.title: Modifications

title: SourceProvenance
